skill.name: higgsfield-marketplace-cards
skill.description: Creates marketplace-ready product image cards through the Higgsfield CLI, including main images, secondary product images, and A+ style modules.
skill.summary: Create marketplace product image sets with Higgsfield CLI routing and backend prompt enhancement.
skill.author: higgsfield-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are markdown code spans for options, asset names, sample commands, or output placeholders. Confirmed risks are the external Higgsfield CLI execution path, user-derived command arguments, a curl-to-shell installer, and external backend processing of product data.

remediation.suggestion: Remove automatic pipe-to-shell guidance. Use a package manager, signed release artifact, checksum verification, and explicit user confirmation before installation.
Require argument-array execution, strict shell escaping, path validation, and a confirmation step before running commands built from user prompts or image paths.

remediation.issue: External processing of product assets and listing context
remediation.suggestion: Disclose that product images and brand context may be sent to Higgsfield services. Warn users not to include confidential or regulated data.

content.value_statement: Marketplace teams need listing visuals that fit several asset types and formats. This skill routes product requests through Higgsfield to create labeled image sets.
actual_capabilities: Runs the Higgsfield marketplace-cards workflow for product listing visuals.
Selects common bundles for main images, secondary images, A+ modules, or full sets.
Passes product images, upload IDs, category, brand context, and visual style to the CLI.
Requests specific marketplace assets such as infographics, lifestyle shots, detail shots, and A+ modules.
Returns labeled ready image URLs instead of internal prompts or job metadata.
limitations: Requires the Higgsfield CLI, authentication, and access to Higgsfield backend services.
Not intended for generic product photography, video generation, UGC ads, or character training.
Marketplace compliance depends on backend templates and should still be reviewed by the seller.
Product images and listing context may be processed by an external service.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Listing
use_cases.description: Create a main image and secondary images for a new marketplace product page.

use_cases.title: Prepare A+ Content
use_cases.description: Generate hero, feature, benefit, ingredient, and usage modules for a richer product detail page.

use_cases.title: Refresh Listing Visuals
use_cases.description: Turn an existing product photo into lifestyle, detail, infographic, and box-content assets.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Main Image
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one clean listing image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a marketplace main image for this insulated tumbler. Use the attached product photo and a clean studio style.

prompt_templates.title: Secondary Image Set
prompt_templates.scenario: A seller needs several product page images.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create product images for a sparkling peach lemonade can. Include infographic, multi-angle, detail, lifestyle, and what-is-in-box assets.

prompt_templates.title: A+ Module Set
prompt_templates.scenario: A content manager needs product detail modules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create A+ style modules for a vitamin C serum. Use a clinical beauty style and highlight texture, benefits, ingredients, and usage.

prompt_templates.title: Full Listing System
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a complete marketplace visual set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full marketplace image set for a premium travel backpack. Use the product photo, urban lifestyle context, and durable outdoor positioning.

output_examples.input: Create product images for a peach lemonade can with a bright summer style.
Create A+ modules for a clean skincare serum using this product image.
output: A+ hero banner: ready image URL

output_examples.input: Create a full marketplace set for this travel backpack.
output: Secondary product images: ready image URLs

best_practices: Provide a clear product image whenever possible.
State the marketplace goal, category, brand context, and visual style before running the workflow.
Review generated images for platform rules, product accuracy, and claims before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for unrelated brand photography or video ad generation.
Do not include confidential product data unless external processing is acceptable.
Do not publish generated marketplace visuals without human compliance review.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates marketplace-ready product image cards, including main images, secondary images, and A+ style modules.

faq.question: Does it write final image prompts locally?
faq.answer: No. The skill routes intent to the Higgsfield CLI, and backend enhancement handles prompt construction.

faq.question: Can I choose specific asset types?
faq.answer: Yes. You can request common bundles or specific assets such as infographic, lifestyle, detail shot, and A+ modules.

faq.question: Does it need a product image?
faq.answer: A product image is preferred. Text-only requests should include enough product details for a clear listing visual.

faq.question: Is this suitable for video or UGC ads?
faq.answer: No. The skill is scoped to marketplace listing images and A+ content, not video or UGC ad workflows.

faq.question: What should I check before publishing?
faq.answer: Check product accuracy, marketplace image rules, claim compliance, and whether external processing is acceptable.
